meta.name: memory
meta.description:
Execute extract and use project memories from previous sessions for context-aware assistance.
Use when recalling past decisions, checking project conventions, or understanding user preferences.
Trigger with phrases like "remember when", "like before", or "what was our decision about".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记住过往会话中的决定与偏好，让后续协助更贴合背景
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望助手能记住之前讨论过的背景和结论
copy.tagline_en: Keep project decisions and preferences across sessions for context-aware help
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to remember prior discussions and outcomes

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会在每次新会话开始时自动读取项目记忆文件,把之前记录的偏好和决定默默应用到回答与操作中。遇到新的重要选择会自动记下来;条目超过 10 条时会自动精简合并,保留重点。
howto.when: 当你提到“remember when”“like before”等短语,或要求回顾过去的决定、检查项目约定、理解你的偏好时触发;新会话开始也会自动加载已存记忆。

say.text: 我们上次为什么决定不用 Vercel?
say.note: Claude 会翻查项目记忆,告诉你当时的理由。

say.text: 像之前一样,用 pnpm 来安装依赖。
say.note: 它会按记忆里偏好的包管理器操作。

say.text: 查一下我们约定的代码命名规范是什么。
say.note: 它会从记忆里提取相关约定并遵守。

howto.what_en: Claude reads the project memory file at session start, silently applies saved preferences and decisions, records new important choices, and consolidates the file when it exceeds 10 entries.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'remember when' or 'like before', asks about past decisions, project conventions, or user preferences, or when a new session starts. Memories load automatically at session start.

say_en.text: Why did we decide not to use Vercel last time?
say_en.note: It searches project memory and recalls the reasoning.

say_en.text: Install dependencies with pnpm, like before.
say_en.note: It follows the remembered package manager preference.

say_en.text: What's our agreed naming convention for code?
say_en.note: It retrieves the convention from memory and follows it.
